n: Saint Elijah the Prophet Serbian Orthodox Church
w: Carved into sandstone between 3 and 17 metres underground, this Serbian Orthodox church opened in 1993 and remains a working parish -- complete with a community hall, parish house and religious school, all excavated below Coober Pedy's opal-mining dugouts.
_facts: Built 1993, carved into sandstone 3-17 metres underground
Dedicated to Saint Elijah; under the Serbian Orthodox Metropolitanate of Australia and New Zealand
Complex includes a community hall, parish house and religious school, all underground
A popular tourist attraction because of its underground location
